metric_scope: complete native HOSI metrics; window FK/voxel proxies separately named

repair_diagnosis.interpretation: Trial reasons are descriptive, co-occurring constraints, not independent statistical samples. The shared step size can limit all pose coordinates when stance binds.
repair_diagnosis.metric_definition: repair_rms_mm is RMS over future FK coordinate components, relative to the geometry proposal

historical_infbagel_reference.scope: Historical pre-P12 representation/evaluator; matching task identities but different generation/noise/decoder protocol; descriptive external reference.
historical_infbagel_reference.schema_note: Initial read-only extraction requested aggregate completion_rate from per-task rows and raised KeyError; corrected to compute native endpoint completion explicitly. No output was overwritten or motion regenerated.

visual_review_scope: Four complete preselected videos with native SDF surface samples; complete numerical motion/seam audit. Skeleton views do not establish perceptual naturalness.
decision_scope: Development on28 already-exploratory native test tasks. Shared editor improves B0; additional HSI gain remains unestablished. Historical InfBaGel row is descriptive, pre-P12 and protocol-mismatched. No claim of surpassing InfBaGel.
